**Logs**
Attach these from your installed folder (not the mod kit):
- `Runtime/VR/compositor.log` (the last `hostExit=` line matters most)

Please do not attach saves, game files or your whole installed folder.
See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](../../TROUBLESHOOTING.md) first; many problems are covered there.
